projectionHistory: Initial reviewer projection joined multiple spans with commas, producing one projection-format error; corrected to schema semicolons and rerun. No R4 input changed.
limitations: The six current placeholders were located by reviewer inspection, not automatically by this projected validator run.
34 test rows omit explicit spans; one declares partial spans. These are insufficient FULL_READ proof, not proof that source was never read.
Legacy R4 does not carry the new binding contract, so its old fast-gate pass alone does not invoke this projection.
reviewConclusion: Improved mechanical consistency checking: one bounded validator pass reports set/count/identity/read-span gaps. No claim of reduced total review time or semantic correctness.
nextRepairScope: Add terminal rows for test/memorable-relay.test.ts and test/turn-context.test.ts; do not infer reading from candidate discovery.
Attach exact blob identities to 37 existing test rows at the pinned source; preserve earlier declarations as history.
Supply real span provenance for 34 rows without spans; retain the one explicitly partial row as partial unless completed or exact-blob prior READ receipt exists.
Reconcile 41 candidates against all processing rows and two justified exclusions.
Replace six current result placeholders with actual command receipts while preserving failed-run history.
Migrate the corrected return using the accepted evidence binding; retain original R4 bytes as the comparison baseline.
Re-review M3/M4/M6 safety/control-flow claims after structural readiness; do not treat validator PASS as semantic proof.
